native.scope: Real Godot input/UI handlers and TCP client against Studio; synthetic key events, not physical keyboard automation

firmware: Existing ADASLab ID3 version2; no Flash programming required
limitations: Godot input tests use synthetic events through normal engine input handlers, not physical keyboard automation.
Native graphics and hardware were tested on macOS; Windows/Linux launch paths were not run on those operating systems.
FPS is an observation for this test run, not a performance guarantee.
